For a model built over a proper subset of `n.snapshots`, `solve_model` passes the full `n.snapshots` to `_call_extra_functionality`, rather than reading the model’s stored snapshots. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that full index unchanged, so the callback receives snapshots outside those the model was built over.
